title: CRDT Counter
description: Build Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) including G-Counter and PN-Counter with merge semantics.

steps.title: Implement G-Counter (grow-only counter)
steps.description: Create a G-Counter CRDT that uses per-replica state. Each replica has an ID and a vector of counts indexed by replica ID. Implement `increment()` and `value()` (sum of all counts). Print the counter value after several increments from different replicas.
hints: Store state as an object mapping replicaId to integer count, initialized to 0
increment() only increases the calling replica's own entry in the vector
value() returns the sum of all entries in the vector

verification.successMessage: G-Counter returns correct accumulated value after increments
verification.failureMessage: Counter value not displayed in output

steps.title: Add merge for G-Counter
steps.description: Implement a `merge(other)` method that combines two G-Counter states by taking the element-wise maximum of each replica's count. After merging two diverged replicas, print both the pre-merge and post-merge states to show convergence.
hints: For each replica ID present in either counter, take Math.max of the two counts
After merge, both replicas should have identical state
Test by incrementing each replica differently, then merge and verify values match

verification.successMessage: G-Counter merge converges both replicas to the same state
verification.failureMessage: Merge output missing or states do not converge

steps.title: Implement PN-Counter (positive/negative)
steps.description: Build a PN-Counter that supports both increment and decrement by using two internal G-Counters: one for positive increments and one for negative. `value()` returns P - N. Print the net value after mixed increment and decrement operations.
hints: PN-Counter wraps two G-Counters: P (positive) and N (negative/ decrements)
increment(n) adds n to P; decrement(n) adds n to N

verification.successMessage: PN-Counter produces correct net value after increments and decrements
verification.failureMessage: PN-Counter value missing or incorrect in output

steps.title: Add state-based merge
steps.description: Implement full state-based merge for PN-Counter by merging the internal P and N G-Counters independently. Demonstrate convergence by creating three replicas, applying different operations, merging pairwise, and printing all states.
hints: Merge P with P using G-Counter merge, and N with N using G-Counter merge
Merging is commutative, associative, and idempotent (satisfying CRDT properties)
After full pairwise merge, all replicas must report the same value()

verification.successMessage: All replicas converge to identical values after state merge
verification.failureMessage: Replicas do not converge or merge output incomplete

steps.title: Implement observed-remove set
steps.description: Build an OR-Set (Observed-Remove Set) that supports add and remove operations. Use unique tags per element to track additions. A remove only takes effect if all observed add tags are present. Print the set membership after add/remove/merge cycles.
hints: Store elements as {value, tag} pairs where tag is a unique ID per add operation
The addSet contains all {value, tag} pairs ever added; each add generates a new tag
removeSet stores tags to remove; an element is present if added at least once and not removed since

verification.successMessage: OR-Set correctly handles add, remove, and membership queries
verification.failureMessage: OR-Set membership output missing or incorrect

steps.title: Build replication simulator
steps.description: Create a simulator with multiple CRDT replicas that start from 0, apply random operations, and sync periodically. After each sync round, print all replica states and verify they have converged to the same value.
hints: Create an array of replicas, each with an ID and a reference to a shared network
Simulate a sync round by merging each replica with every other replica
Track convergence by checking that all replicas report the same value() after full sync

verification.successMessage: All replicas converge to the same value after simulated replication
verification.failureMessage: Replica values differ after sync or convergence not demonstrated
